Name: Sweet Donuts Recipe
Author: mengyi06
Description:
Add a burst of fresh flavor to your Stardew Valley kitchen with this donut-focused mod! Now you can craft six delightful new donut varieties using seasonal ingredients, each offering unique boosts to enhance your farming journey:

[list]
[*]Blueberry Donut: A fluffy treat studded with plump blueberries, delivering a sweet-tart berry explosion in every bite.
[*]Cranberry Donut: Tangy-sweet cranberry glaze coats this moist donut, perfect for a zesty morning pick-me-up.
[*]Green Bean Donut: A unique twist with smooth green bean paste filling, balancing subtle earthy sweetness and a tender texture.
[*]Mango Donut: Tropical paradise in a donut—juicy mango chunks swirled into the batter for a refreshing, sun-ripened taste.
[*]Peach Donut: Fragrant and juicy, filled with fresh peach puree that captures the essence of summer harvests.
[*]Starfruit Donut: Bright and exotic, featuring starfruit’s signature tangy-sweet flavor, making it a standout bakery item.
[/list]
